title: An order that validates, totals, renders, and saves
task: Build the `order` package: an order has lines (`SKU`, unit cents, quantity); validation reports no lines or a non-positive quantity as an error naming the offending SKU; totals add 7% tax rounded to the nearest cent; a plain-text receipt renders one line per item and the total; and an order can be saved through a `Store` interface. Each of those is a separate reason to change.
